analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($733.51) below SMA5 ($746.19), SMA20 ($757.11), SMA50 ($765.67): diagnosing short-to-medium term trend weakness.
· Below SMA100 ($762.51), above SMA200 ($733.09): indicating potential shift to medium-to-long term downtrend.
· 52-week position (66.3%) + current price level approaching historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (47.1→36.6): entering oversold territory, strengthening downward momentum.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.9456→-2.1936): bearish trend continuation, dead cross maintained.
· Bollinger Band current price position (near lower band $731.19) + 6.85% band width contraction, increasing downward pressure.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($732.50): near current price, testing support level.
· Swing resistance ($753.02): resistance zone for short-term bounces.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (Lower Low): signaling continued downtrend.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.86): contracted volume, suggesting potential weakening of the downtrend.
· Current phase diagnosis (Downtrend): possibility of breaking $732.50 support on further decline, condition for maintaining wait-and-see stance.
